term.label: 2A_self_cleaving_peptide_region

definition.text: A region that codes for a 2A self-cleaving polypeptide region, which is a region that can result in a break in the peptide sequence at its terminal G-P junction.

comments: Added by Dave Sant on October 21, 2019 per github request https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/475
